summary: Iteration 38 — E2E testing of Marketing Phase expansion: Meta connection section (no-credentials scenario), multi-channel campaigns with objectives (awareness/leads/reativação), and regression of existing marketing flows. All 18 backend tests passed (test_phase3_marketing.py).
